items.title: Coinbase Stock Jumped 12% Last Friday. Bitcoin’s Breakout Wasn’t the Only Reason.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBitcoin Breakout: Coinbase stock jumped 12% on Friday, September 18, as bitcoin cleared $80,000 for the first time in weeks, making COIN the S&P 500’s top percentage gainer that session. Split Verdict: The Street carries 18 buys, 3 outperforms, 11 holds, one underperform and one sell on Coinbase stock, with a $202 mean target sitting just 4% above Friday’s close.
